dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

California Gurl was surrendered to the care center as a stray and we have limited history on her behavior in a home environment, although a friend of the previous owner reported that she has instigated altercations with the other resident dog in the home, on one occasion resulting in a bite to the other dog that broke skin. California Gurl has not acclimated well to the care center environment and has allowed minimal handling since intake. She has shown highly fearful behavior, retreating in her kennel, avoiding leashing, and escalating to growling at staff during intake. Due to these concerns, we recommend placement with a New Hope partner who can allow for decompression, provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based), and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: California Gurl
